steps.description: Create a new note in Markor named {file_name} with the given text content, per markor.MarkorCreateNote invoked as self.markor_task in initialize_task().

Share the entire content of the note with the phone number {number} via SMS using Simple SMS Messenger, per the task's own template: 'Share the entire content of the note with the phone number {number} via SMS using Simple SMS Messenger'.
